critical.msg: _Lock.__enter__ lost atomic os.O_EXCL create; now has TOCTOU race — two concurrent runs can both pass the exists-check and write, breaking mutual exclusion. Revert to os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY) or use fcntl.flock.

_gh_open_pr token embedded via f-string interpolation into curl -H header; visible in /proc/<pid>/cmdline. Must pass via environment variable (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN env var or PIPELINE_GH_TOKEN as before).
datetime.fromisoformat(...).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) removed — rstrip('Z') alone does NOT convert local time to UTC; the timestamp comparison (age_h < 24) will be wrong for non-UTC timezones.
'implement' removed from _collect_stats agent list; orchestrator stats will skip implement stage entirely.

warnings: Bare `except:` (lines 96, 56, 77, 45) — catches all exceptions including FileNotFoundError, JSONDecodeError, silently swallowing errors
pipeline.py line 76: `re` moved inside function; top-level import still present (duplicate)
pipeline.py line 781: already-parsed task dict discarded, file re-read immediately with json.loads(pending.read_text())
.gitignore removed shared-memory/ entirely — now only subdirs; stale git-tracked shared-memory content could still be committed
pipeline.py: PIPELINE_NO_DOTENV mechanism removed — tests can no longer opt out of .env loading, breaking test isolation
suggestions: pipeline-test.yml writes to pipeline-artifacts/ while other workflows use artifacts/ — normalize to artifacts/ for consistency
Timezone guard (age_h < 0.5, age_h < 24) should also validate the parsed datetime is timezone-aware before subtraction
Consider adding timeout to _Lock.__enter__ flock call to prevent indefinite blocking
llm_parsed.summary: 4 critical-severity issues found. Two security vulnerabilities: (1) _Lock lost its atomic exclusive-create and is now a TOCTOU race condition, breaking mutual exclusion between concurrent runs. (2) GitHub token embedded directly in curl -H header via f-string, exposing it in /proc/<pid>/cmdline. Two quality/architecture issues: (3) timezone conversion removed — rstrip('Z') does not make a naive datetime timezone-aware; time comparisons will be incorrect in non-UTC timezones. (4) 'implement' dropped from stats collection loop, so orchestrator stats will skip that stage.
